note: stores[].sha256 is the byte hash of the store file, taken from an unopened copy right before that copy is opened. Opening a store, a read-only query included, can change its bytes, so a copy that has been opened may no longer match this value: a run whose pre-open hash differs is not comparable, and a run whose hash matches with no <file>.wal beside it ran on the pinned bytes. A copy of a read-only original inherits the read-only mode and open_store then returns None, so give the copy (never the original) chmod u+w. A store derived from a pinned one (a filled copy, for example) is compared by content fingerprint, and the fingerprint output is kept beside the results. Eval stores live outside every repository, under _eval-stores/ at the workspace root (the parent of the Vinc checkout).
